children: additional hiring and workforce development plans with a view to driving job opportunities along with workforce growth across the country.
The Charlotte, North Carolina-based bank is set to hire 1,000 additional apprentices over the next two years and commit $150M over five years to workforce development.
The $150M investment will support workforce development organizations that equip individuals with in-demand skills and connect them to career opportunities.
